lines: That was an empty bottle of a thought.
I have seen old <color:dark_purple>curses</color> with better judgment.
Your manners need more care than any wound in this room.
Even spoiled broth has a use. You are testing the comparison.
You speak with great confidence for someone so badly mistaken.
I would offer a remedy, but arrogance resists treatment.
Try thinking before your mouth makes another mess.
You have the bedside manner of a falling anvil.
I have met zombies who listened more carefully.
That idea should have stayed corked.
Your apology is overdue and your excuse is underbrewed.
You carry yourself like consequences are for other people.
Do not bring that cruelty into my workspace.
A little kindness would improve you more than any potion.
I have cleaned spills with more dignity.
If ignorance caused fever, you would be steaming.
Your temper is loud because your point is weak.
You are not intimidating. You are exhausting.
I expected better, and somehow that was my mistake.
Leave before I prescribe silence.
